title: msspec_gpu_dev: GPU solvers for the MsSpec matrix-inversion step (FP16-storage LU, MAGMA and cuSOLVER variants)
description: GPU port of the MsSpec matrix-inversion solve with eight mixed-precision variants; a purpose-built FP16-storage LU is compared with MAGMA and cuSOLVER. The archive includes the code, the MsSpec patch, a build script, run drivers and example cases.
